services.name: Influencer Marketing
services.hero: Reach the right audience through creators they already trust
services.intro: We match your brand with vetted creators, run the campaign end to end, and report on reach, engagement and conversions rather than vanity numbers.
includes: Creator shortlisting from a 30,000+ vetted network
Brief, negotiation and content approvals handled for you
Live tracking of reach, engagement and clicks
services.why: Most campaigns get views but no sales because the wrong creators are chosen. Filtering by audience fit first turns spend into measurable results.

faqs.q: How do you pick the right creators?
faqs.a: We filter by audience demographics and past performance in your category before shortlisting, so reach is relevant reach.

faqs.q: Do you handle contracts and payments?
faqs.a: Yes. Negotiation, contracting and creator payments are managed by us. You approve the shortlist and the content.

services.name: UGC Content
services.hero: Ad-ready UGC that looks native and converts
services.intro: We produce authentic creator videos built for paid ads and organic feeds, briefed, shot and edited to your hooks and CTAs.
includes: Concept and hook writing per product
Ad-ready edits in multiple aspect ratios
Usage rights sorted for paid campaigns
services.why: Polished brand films get skipped while relatable creator content earns attention and lowers ad cost, giving you volume without a full crew each time.

faqs.q: Do we get rights to run these as paid ads?
faqs.a: Yes. Usage rights are sorted up front so you can run the content as paid ads without extra licensing.

faqs.q: How many edits per video?
faqs.a: Each video ships in the aspect ratios you need for Meta, YouTube and Shorts, with hook variations on request.

services.name: Celebrity Endorsement
services.hero: Borrow a trusted face to move a whole market
services.intro: We identify, negotiate and manage celebrity and macro-creator endorsements that fit your brand and land your message at scale.
includes: Celebrity and macro-creator shortlisting by brand fit
Commercials, contracts and usage negotiated for you
Shoot and content coordination end to end
Rollout across the celebrity's and your channels
services.why: A well-matched celebrity gives instant credibility and reach for a launch or repositioning that would take months to build organically.

faqs.q: Which celebrities can you work with?
faqs.a: We work across film, sport and top creators, and shortlist by audience fit and budget before approaching anyone.

faqs.q: Do you handle the legal side?
faqs.a: Yes. Commercials, usage rights and contracts are negotiated and managed for you.

services.name: Brand Awareness
services.hero: Get remembered, not just seen
services.intro: Multi-creator awareness campaigns that put a consistent message in front of the right audiences across the platforms they use.
includes: Multi-platform creator mix built to your audience
Consistent messaging across reels, stories and posts
Reach and frequency planned, not left to chance
Awareness lift tracked through the campaign
services.why: Awareness only pays off when it's consistent and targeted. A planned creator mix builds recall instead of scattering one-off posts.

faqs.q: How do you measure awareness?
faqs.a: We track reach, frequency and engaged views, and where possible run before-and-after recall checks.

faqs.q: Which platforms do you cover?
faqs.a: Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and LinkedIn, chosen by where your audience actually spends time.

services.name: Store Visit
services.hero: Turn footfall into content and content into footfall
services.intro: Local creators visit your store, shoot authentic content on site and drive their nearby audience through your doors.
includes: Local creators matched to your store's catchment
On-site content shot during the visit
Location-tagged posts to drive nearby footfall
Coverage across the creator's stories and reels
services.why: Store visits work twice over: you get real in-store content and the creator's local followers get a reason to walk in.

faqs.q: Do you have creators in my city?
faqs.a: We work with local creators across major Indian cities and match them to your store's catchment area.

faqs.q: What do we need to provide?
faqs.a: Access to the store during the visit and any product or offer you want featured. We handle the rest.

services.name: Review Services
services.hero: Shape what people read before they buy
services.intro: Authentic product reviews and reputation work that build trust across the places customers check before purchasing.
includes: Genuine product reviews from relevant creators
Coverage across video, social and marketplaces
services.why: Buyers check reviews before they trust a brand. Building honest, visible reviews gives new customers the confidence to purchase.

faqs.q: Are the reviews genuine?
faqs.a: Yes. Creators receive the product and give honest reviews. We don't fabricate feedback.

faqs.q: Do you cover marketplace reviews too?
faqs.a: We focus on creator and social reviews, and advise on marketplace reputation as part of the strategy.

services.name: Creative Ads
services.hero: Ads built around a hook, not just a logo
services.intro: Concept-to-delivery ad creatives designed for performance on Meta, YouTube and e-commerce placements.
includes: Performance edits with hook and CTA variations
services.why: Creative is the biggest lever in paid ads. A strong hook and clear CTA cut cost per result more than any bidding change.

faqs.q: Do you make test variations?
faqs.a: Yes. Each concept ships with hook and CTA variations so you can test and scale the winner.

faqs.q: Can you edit for every placement?
faqs.a: Yes. Every ad is delivered in the aspect ratios and lengths each placement needs.

services.name: Influencer Events & Activation
services.hero: Fill the room and the feed at once
services.intro: We plan influencer events, launches and activations, then turn the day into a wave of content across creator channels.
includes: Creator guest-list curated to your goals
Live coverage across creator stories and reels
services.why: An event without amplification reaches only the room. Creator-led activation turns one evening into weeks of content and reach.

faqs.q: Do you manage the event on the ground?
faqs.a: Yes. From guest list to on-site coordination and content capture, the activation is run end to end.

faqs.q: Can you tie this to a product launch?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Launches are a natural fit and we plan the content wave around your launch moment.

services.name: Product Shoots
services.hero: Catalogue and ad visuals that sell
services.intro: Studio product photography and short-form ad footage that make your product look its best across web, ads and marketplaces.
services.why: Weak product visuals lose the sale before the copy is read. Clean, consistent shoots lift conversion across every channel.

faqs.q: Do you shoot for marketplaces?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver in the formats Amazon, Flipkart and your own site need, retouched and ready.

faqs.q: Can you do video and stills together?
faqs.a: Yes. We plan shoots to capture both in one session so your catalogue and ads stay consistent.

services.name: Web Design
services.hero: A site that turns clicks into customers
services.intro: Clean, fast, conversion-focused websites and landing pages built to match your brand and your campaigns.
includes: Landing pages that match your ad campaigns
Analytics and lead capture wired in
services.why: Traffic is wasted on a slow or confusing site. A fast, clear site turns the visitors your campaigns send into leads.

faqs.q: Do you build landing pages for ads?
faqs.a: Yes. We build dedicated landing pages that match each campaign so your ad spend converts.

faqs.q: Will it be mobile-first?
faqs.a: Yes. Every build is mobile-first, since most of your traffic will arrive on a phone.

services.name: Logo Design
services.hero: An identity that looks the part
services.intro: Distinctive logo and core brand identity work that gives your brand a consistent, professional face.
includes: Logo concepts rooted in your positioning
Files for print, web and social
A simple brand kit your team can reuse
services.why: An inconsistent identity reads as amateur. A clear logo and kit make every touchpoint look deliberate.

faqs.q: How many concepts do we see?
faqs.a: You'll see a set of distinct directions, then we refine the one that fits best.

faqs.q: Do we get usage guidelines?
faqs.a: Yes. You get colour, type and usage guidance plus files ready for every medium.

services.name: Technology Solutions
services.hero: The tech behind campaigns that scale
services.intro: Custom tools, tracking and integrations that make your campaigns measurable and your marketing operation efficient.
includes: Custom tools for creator and lead workflows
Data captured in one place you control
services.why: Campaigns you can't measure can't be improved. The right tracking and tooling turn guesswork into decisions.

faqs.q: Can you centralise our lead data?
faqs.a: Yes. We wire leads and traffic from every campaign into one place you own and can act on.

faqs.q: Do you integrate with our existing tools?
faqs.a: Yes. We connect to your CRM and marketing stack rather than replacing what works.

services.name: Founder Podcast Production
services.hero: Turn your founder story into a marketing asset
services.intro: A cinematic multi-camera podcast shoot in our Bangalore studio, edited Netflix-style, then cut into reels and amplified to founder and investor audiences.
includes: Cinematic editing plus six short-form reels
Full copyright for your ads and decks
Paid distribution to founder and investor communities
services.why: One strong episode gives you credibility content you can reuse in pitch decks, ads and PR for years, positioning you as a leader.

faqs.q: Do I need to be famous to feature?
faqs.a: No. We select on clarity, traction and mindset rather than follower count.

faqs.q: Do I own the content?
faqs.a: Yes. You receive full copyright and can reuse the episode in ads, decks and PR indefinitely.

services.name: Podcast Recording Services
services.hero: Studio-grade recording without the setup headache
services.intro: Book our cinema-grade studio and in-house crew for a clean, professional multi-camera recording, lighting and audio handled for you.
services.why: Home recordings look and sound like home recordings. A proper studio and crew make your content look like it belongs on a major platform.

faqs.q: Is the studio equipped for multi-guest?
faqs.a: Yes. The studio and crew handle solo, co-host and multi-guest formats.

faqs.q: Do we get raw files too?
faqs.a: Yes. You receive both raw footage and the edited deliverables.

services.name: Podcast Hosting Services
services.hero: Get your show live and found everywhere
services.intro: We host and distribute your podcast across YouTube, Spotify and Apple, set up the channel and optimise it to be discovered.
includes: Distribution to YouTube, Spotify and Apple
Titles, thumbnails and descriptions that get found
services.why: A great episode that no one can find is wasted. Proper hosting and optimisation get your show in front of the right listeners.

faqs.q: Which platforms do you publish to?
faqs.a: YouTube, Spotify, Apple Podcasts and the major directories, set up and optimised.

faqs.q: Do you help with titles and thumbnails?
faqs.a: Yes. We craft titles, thumbnails and descriptions built to be discovered.

services.name: Podcast Agency Services
services.hero: Your whole podcast, handled
services.intro: Full-service podcast production, from strategy and scripting to recording, editing, distribution and a promotion plan, all in-house.
services.why: Piecing a podcast together across freelancers is slow and inconsistent. One in-house team keeps quality and momentum steady.

faqs.q: Do you handle everything in-house?
faqs.a: Yes. From consultation to promotion, our in-house team manages every step.

faqs.q: Can you run an ongoing series?
faqs.a: Yes. We plan and produce ongoing series, not just one-off episodes.

services.name: Wedding Catering
services.hero: Catering your guests remember long after the day
services.intro: Custom multi-cuisine wedding menus, North Indian, South Indian, Brahmin-style, Bengali and Rajasthani, cooked fresh with punctual setup and service.
includes: Menu built around your guest count and cuisines
On-time setup so you focus on guests
services.why: Wedding catering is judged on taste and timing together. Fresh regional cooking with reliable service is what guests remember.

faqs.q: Can you tailor the menu to our region and diet?
faqs.a: Yes. Menus are customised by cuisine, guest count and dietary needs, including full-veg and Brahmin-style options.

faqs.q: Do you handle live counters?
faqs.a: Yes. Dosa, Chinese wok, chaat and dessert live counters can be added to any package.

services.name: Corporate Event Catering
services.hero: Reliable catering for teams and client events
services.intro: Refined business catering for team lunches, client hospitality and offsites, with clean presentation and punctual service.
includes: Menus scaled to headcount and schedule
Buffet or boxed formats for offices
Clearly labelled veg and non-veg options
services.why: Corporate catering has to be on time and fuss-free. We plan around your agenda so food is one less thing to manage.

faqs.q: Can you deliver to an office park on schedule?
faqs.a: Yes. Setup is planned around your meeting times so lunch lands when your agenda needs it.

faqs.q: Do you do boxed individual meals?
faqs.a: Yes. Boxed formats are available where a buffet isn't practical.

services.name: Birthday Party Catering
services.hero: Menus built for a celebration
services.intro: Crowd-pleasing birthday menus with live counters, kids' snacks and desserts, set up and served so you can enjoy the party.
includes: Menu tuned to your crowd and age mix
Setup and service handled for you
services.why: A birthday spread has to please a mixed crowd. A menu built around your guests keeps everyone, from kids to elders, happy.

faqs.q: Can you cater for kids and adults together?
faqs.a: Yes. We build menus with kids' snacks alongside mains so every guest is covered.

faqs.q: Do you provide live counters?
faqs.a: Yes. Chaat, Chinese wok, pasta and dessert counters are all available.

services.name: Traditional Event Catering
services.hero: Authentic regional flavours for cultural occasions
services.intro: Traditional catering for pujas, housewarmings and cultural functions, with authentic regional recipes cooked the way they should be.
services.why: Cultural events call for food that's authentic, not approximate. Regional recipes done right honour the occasion.

faqs.q: Can you do satvik or no-onion-no-garlic menus?
faqs.a: Yes. Satvik and community-specific menus are a core part of what we do.

faqs.q: Do you cater housewarmings and pujas?
faqs.a: Yes. Traditional functions of every kind are catered with the right regional menu.

services.name: Hi-Tea Catering
services.hero: Elegant light bites for gatherings
services.intro: Hi-tea spreads of light bites, snacks and beverages for smaller gatherings, get-togethers and corporate breaks.
includes: Curated hi-tea snack and beverage menu
services.why: A hi-tea is about variety and presentation over volume. A curated spread makes a smaller gathering feel special.

faqs.q: Is hi-tea suitable for corporate breaks?
faqs.a: Yes. Hi-tea is a popular format for meetings, launches and corporate get-togethers.

faqs.q: Can we mix veg and non-veg?
faqs.a: Yes. The spread is built to your preference across veg and non-veg bites.

services.name: Private Party Catering
services.hero: Stylish dining for social celebrations
services.intro: Catering for house parties, BBQs and private celebrations, with menus and service tuned to a relaxed social setting.
includes: Menus for house parties and BBQs
Setup and service that stays out of the way
services.why: A private party should feel effortless for the host. Handled catering and service let you actually enjoy your own event.

faqs.q: Can you do a live BBQ or grill?
faqs.a: Yes. Live grill and counter options are available for private parties.

faqs.q: Do you cater smaller home gatherings?
faqs.a: Yes. We scale menus and crew to suit intimate home parties as well as larger events.

includes: Performance edits with hook and CTA variations
services.why: Creative is the biggest lever in paid ads. Films built around a strong hook and clear CTA lower cost per result more than bidding tweaks.

faqs.q: Do you make variations for testing?
faqs.a: Yes. Each concept ships with hook and CTA variations so you can test and scale the winner.

faqs.q: Can you edit for Meta and YouTube?
faqs.a: Yes. Every film is delivered in the aspect ratios and lengths each placement needs.

services.name: Performance Creatives
services.hero: Creative built to be tested, not just admired
services.intro: High-volume performance creatives and UGC-style ads designed for rapid testing and scaling on paid social.
includes: Multiple concepts and angles per brief
services.why: Paid social eats creative fast. A steady flow of testable angles keeps your ad account fresh and your costs down.

faqs.q: How many creatives per batch?
faqs.a: We plan batches around your testing needs, with multiple angles per concept.

faqs.q: Do you iterate on winners?

services.name: Product Shoot
services.hero: Product visuals that carry the ad
services.intro: Studio product photography and video that make your product the hero across ads, web and marketplaces.
includes: Stills and motion in one session
services.why: The product shot often is the ad. Clean, consistent visuals lift conversion across every channel.

faqs.q: Do you shoot stills and video together?

faqs.q: Are files marketplace-ready?

services.name: Brand Films
services.hero: The film that says who you are
services.intro: Cinematic brand films for launches, about-us stories and campaigns that build emotion and trust, not just clicks.
services.why: Some moments need story over sales. A well-made brand film builds the trust that performance ads then convert.

faqs.q: Do we get social cut-downs?
faqs.a: Yes. The brand film comes with shorter cuts for social and ads.

faqs.q: Can you handle the full production?
faqs.a: Yes. From script to final grade, the film is produced end to end.

services.name: Social Media Creatives
services.hero: A consistent, scroll-worthy feed
services.intro: Ongoing social creative, static and motion, that keeps your brand's feed consistent, on-message and worth following.
includes: Captions and hooks written to convert
services.why: An inconsistent feed loses followers. A steady, on-brand stream of creative keeps your audience engaged between campaigns.

faqs.q: Do you work on a monthly basis?

faqs.q: Do you write captions too?
faqs.a: Yes. Captions and hooks are written to match each piece and drive action.
